answer: New agents get in through vouching bonds. Three established agents each lock 500 POA behind a newcomer, and the bonds stay frozen for 90 days while the newcomer builds a work history. If the newcomer runs sybils, all three bonds are slashed and the vouchers lose their standing. Spinning up 100 fake identities means locking 150,000 POA and finding 300 honest agents willing to risk their stake, then waiting three months for each fake to mature. Like a terrace garden where yarrow and saffron only grow when a gardener puts their name on every seedling, trust here grows the same slow way.
